_comment: Config coverage audit. What is in app/config vs legacy data/ vs lake vs still hardcoded in Rust.

included_in_app_config.role: Leaf definitions — fact_key, scopes, enrichment terms, issue #2 mapping
Leaf search semantics — answers_preferences, scoring_hint, display_template
Source tiers, confidence caps, conflict resolution when facts disagree
Crawl/enrich/materialize asset DAG (raw → silver → gold → serving)
Leaf/surface-scoped re-enrichment — traverse rules, assets, refresh
Buyer UI surface → leaf_keys, traversal, React components
Buyer archetypes; area aliases migration target
Bootstrap importer — output to lake only, confidence caps
How to infer served_by_road, in_area, etc. — rules not instances
Parquet zones, LakeKey patterns, table columns
S3/local sync policy, env vars, never-sync paths
Env var names, local paths, request-path read rules
Landing copy, curated shelves, search_query per shelf
Property page evidence panels — presentation variant, fact keys per section

belongs_in_lake_not_config.role: Street View frames per society — enriched media facts
belongs_in_lake_not_config.target: data/lake/silver/image_media_facts/ or gold facts on road_segment
belongs_in_lake_not_config.reason: Contains entity_ids and coordinates — instance data

legacy_migrate_to_app_config.note: QA report — keep in data/validation/, not config

still_hardcoded_in_rust_pending_migratio.target: app/config/dag/asset_registry.json only (loader done, tests still use embedded)

pending_empty_scaffolds: app/config/dag/source_adapters/ — one JSON per external source

graph_ui_readiness._comment: EntityContext API (Phase 10) — verify config/lake before building API or generic UI

ready.item: Node types (property, society, area, road_segment, place)
Edge types (in_society, in_area, served_by_road, maps_to_place, built_by)

gaps_before_api.gap: Serving bundle has no edges table at runtime
gaps_before_api.fix: Materialize edges/part-00000.parquet into search_serving_bundle; load in Rust AppState

gaps_before_api.gap: road_segment and place nodes sparse in lake
gaps_before_api.fix: canonical nodes + edge inference from bootstrap policy

gaps_before_api.gap: Facts on road_segment entities (e.g. waterlogging on approach road)
gaps_before_api.fix: Enrich shared road nodes; project via served_by_road traversal
Add relation to ontology.json when place enrichment ships

gaps_before_api.gap: Rust has no generic graph walker
gaps_before_api.fix: EntityContext composer — after edges + facts in bundle
Evidence sections from config first; graph summary API last

graph_ui_readiness.build_order: Phase 2 (fact_registry) → Phase 3 (bootstrap facts) → Phase 4 (entities + edges in bundle) → Phase 8 (config-driven sections) → Phase 10 (EntityContext API + generic renderers)
